tenderSchedule.title: PRODUCTION AND SUPPLY OF PAPER BASED EXCISE ADHESIVE LABELS
tenderSchedule.description: PRODUCTION AND SUPPLY OF PAPER BASED EXCISE ADHESIVE LABELS

tenderAddress.blockNumber: Office of the Commissioner of Excise 2nd Floor, TTMC A Block, BMTC Building, KH Road, Shantinagar, Bengaluru - 560 027, Karnataka.

tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description:
Tenderers should not be associated, or have been associated in the
 past, directly or indirectly, with a firm or any of its affiliates which  have been engaged by the Purchaser to provide consulting services for the  preparation of the design, specifications, and other documents to be used  for the procurement of the goods to be purchased under this Invitation of  Tenders.


Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
All terms and conditions as per tender document.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The tenderer shall be a security printer of good reputation and shall be a manufacturer of paper based Excise Adhesive Label (EAL). The Tenderer should be having in house facilities of designing, multi color web Offset Printing, Intaglio printing machines, machineries related to hologram embossing, lamination, electro forming, slitting, hologram transferring machine, computerized variable data printing machine for check digit, serial numbering and bar-code, machinery for roll making and inspection and any other machinery to fulfill the tender requirements. Self-declaration in this regard, duly certified, to be submitted
The Tenderer shall submit all the documents mentioned in Clause 7.1 of section II - ITT.

The Tenderer, by itself or through acquisition of entity/business, should have supplied item similar to the type specified in the Schedule of Requirements of goods not less than 50% of the annual tendered quantity in any one of the last 3 years and in respect of Micro and Small Enterprises (MSEs), it will be 25% of the tendered quantity in any one of the last 2 years to any State or Union Territory of India or PSUs or any other Government Institutions or supplied through any Government Agency.

The Tenderer shall have an average annual turnover of at least Rs. 100 Crores in the last three preceding financial years, and with respect to Micro and Small Enterprises (MSEs), average annual turnover of at least Rs.50 Crores in the last two preceding financial years. The tenderer will be required to furnish copies of their audited balance sheets in this regard

The Tenderer should be empaneled/certified by at least one of the following agencies viz., Reserve Bank of India (RBI), Indian Bank Association (IBA), National Accreditation Board for Certification Bodies (NABCB), Authentication Solution Providers Association (ASPA) or International Hologram Manufacturers Association (IHMA) for the current financial year i.e., 2026-27 and shall be valid as on date of applying for tender. Relevant certificate to be submitted.

The Tenderer should produce a good performance certificate from their Customers for whom they have executed similar contracts. Certificates issued from concerned head of the Department/competent authority shall be submitted
The Tenderer should be an ISO certified Company/Unit and submit the copy of the certificate

The Tenderer should have infrastructure to produce at least 45 crore PAPER based Excise Adhesive Labels (EAL) per month with all the specified features. The decision of the Purchaser with regard to the capacity assessment shall be final.
The net worth of the Tenderer should not have eroded more than 30% during the last 3 years.
The Tenderer firm should not be black-listed by any State/Central Government Departments/PSUs/Banks during the last 5 years. Declaration as per Section XV shall be submitted.

Tenderer should submit EAL samples at least two rolls of 19,200 EAL of Green Color (within State), as mentioned in Section VI on or before 5:30 P.M on 19/10/2026 Office of the Commissioner of Excise, 2nd Floor, TTMC A Block, BMTC Building, KH Road, Shantinagar, Bengaluru - 560 027, Karnataka, India. The same will be evaluated by the Tender Evaluating Committee. Samples not confirming with the specifications will not qualify for the financial bid.
Tenderer shall not hold or have held any Excise Licence for Manufacturing, Marketing or Sales in any part of India.
The entire EAL Production should be in the premises of the Manufacturer in India. Self-declaration in this regard duly certified to be submitted.
